typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoLifecycle_outputfilename as string (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		INVENTORY_NAME as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string,
		DESK_NAME as string,
		DESK_MANAGER_NAME as string,
		wells_Entity_Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromtblIMGENERICALLSTATUS	source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		TRADE_DATE_TIME as timestamp,
		CCP as string,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string,
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		LONG_NAME as string,
		INTERNAL as string,
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		TRADER_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromCalypso	source(output(
		USER_NAME as string,
		ADENT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromCalypsousername	source(output(
		MKey_BDteCRef as string,
		modif_date as timestamp,
		User_Name as string,
		Calypso_Reference as string,
		Book_Name as string,
		Trade_Status as string,
		Sales_Person as string,
		Trader as string,
		amendment as string,
		amendment_cash as string,
		npv_Change as double,
		fee_Change as double,
		lifecycle as string,
		Business_Date_Rpt as timestamp,
		Field_Amended as string,
		Field_Mapping as string,
		Before as string,
		After as string,
		Action_Status as string,
		End_Status as string,
		Original_Status as string,
		Required_Approval as string,
		mo_AccessGroup as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromOTCCancor	source(output(
		AUName as string,
		ADENT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromTeamMemberDB
FromOTCCancor derive(oCalypso_Reference = toInteger(Calypso_Reference)) ~> DataConversion
FromOTCCancor aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion sort(asc(oCalypso_Reference, false)) ~> SortTradeId
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
SortTradeId,FromCalypso join(oCalypso_Reference == TRADE_ID,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> GetCalypsoFields
GetCalypsoFields derive(MKey_BDteCRef = MKey_BDteCRef,
		modif_date = modif_date,
		User_Name = User_Name,
		Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		Sales_Person = Sales_Person,
		Trader = Trader,
		npv_Change = npv_Change,
		fee_Change = fee_Change,
		lifecycle = lifecycle,
		Business_Date_Rpt = Business_Date_Rpt,
		Field_Amended = Field_Amended,
		Field_Mapping = Field_Mapping,
		Before = Before,
		After = After,
		Action_Status = Action_Status,
		End_Status = End_Status,
		Original_Status = Original_Status,
		oCalypso_Reference = oCalypso_Reference,
		Required_Approval = Required_Approval,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		CCP = CCP,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		LONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		INTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		mo_AccessGroup = mo_AccessGroup) ~> GetCalypsoFields0
GetCalypsoFields0 sort(asc(Book_Name, false)) ~> SortBookName
SortBookName,FromtblIMGENERICALLSTATUS join(Book_Name == INVENTORY_NAME,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeTradeandInvMaster
MergeTradeandInvMaster derive(CCP = CCP,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		LONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		INTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		MKey_BDteCRef = MKey_BDteCRef,
		modif_date = modif_date,
		User_Name = User_Name,
		Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Trader = Trader,
		npv_Change = npv_Change,
		fee_Change = fee_Change,
		lifecycle = lifecycle,
		Business_Date_Rpt = Business_Date_Rpt,
		Field_Amended = Field_Amended,
		Field_Mapping = Field_Mapping,
		Before = Before,
		After = After,
		Action_Status = Action_Status,
		End_Status = End_Status,
		Original_Status = Original_Status,
		Required_Approval = Required_Approval,
		oCalypso_Reference = oCalypso_Reference,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		DESK_NAME = DESK_NAME,
		DESK_MANAGER_NAME = DESK_MANAGER_NAME,
		wells_Entity_Name = wells_Entity_Name,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		Sales_Person = Sales_Person,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		mo_AccessGroup = mo_AccessGroup) ~> MergeTradeandInvMaster0
MergeTradeandInvMaster0 derive(sWellsEntityName = toString((iif(isNull(wells_Entity_Name), 'NOT FOUND IN INV MASTER', wells_Entity_Name))),
		sDeskName = toString((iif(isNull(DESK_NAME), 'NOT FOUND IN INV MASTER', DESK_NAME)))) ~> AssignnullInvMaster
AssignnullInvMaster sort(asc(User_Name, false)) ~> Sortusername
Sortusername,FromCalypsousername join(MergeTradeandInvMaster0@User_Name == FromCalypsousername@USER_NAME,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> mergeusernameADENT
mergeusernameADENT derive(CCP = CCP,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		LONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		INTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		MKey_BDteCRef = MKey_BDteCRef,
		modif_date = modif_date,
		User_Name = User_Name,
		Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Trader = Trader,
		npv_Change = npv_Change,
		fee_Change = fee_Change,
		lifecycle = lifecycle,
		Business_Date_Rpt = Business_Date_Rpt,
		Field_Amended = Field_Amended,
		Field_Mapping = Field_Mapping,
		Before = Before,
		After = After,
		Action_Status = Action_Status,
		End_Status = End_Status,
		Original_Status = Original_Status,
		Required_Approval = Required_Approval,
		oCalypso_Reference = oCalypso_Reference,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		DESK_MANAGER_NAME = DESK_MANAGER_NAME,
		sWellsEntityName = sWellsEntityName,
		sDeskName = sDeskName,
		ADENT = ADENT,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		Sales_Person = Sales_Person,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		mo_AccessGroup = mo_AccessGroup) ~> mergeusernameADENT0
mergeusernameADENT0 sort(asc(ADENT, false)) ~> SortADENT
SortADENT,FromTeamMemberDB join(mergeusernameADENT0@ADENT == FromTeamMemberDB@ADENT,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin select(mapColumn(
		CCP = CCP,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		LONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		INTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		MKey_BDteCRef = MKey_BDteCRef,
		modif_date = modif_date,
		Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Trader = Trader,
		npv_Change = npv_Change,
		fee_Change = fee_Change,
		lifecycle = lifecycle,
		Business_Date_Rpt = Business_Date_Rpt,
		Field_Amended = Field_Amended,
		Field_Mapping = Field_Mapping,
		Before = Before,
		After = After,
		Action_Status = Action_Status,
		End_Status = End_Status,
		Original_Status = Original_Status,
		Required_Approval = Required_Approval,
		oCalypso_Reference = oCalypso_Reference,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		DESK_MANAGER_NAME = DESK_MANAGER_NAME,
		sWellsEntityName = sWellsEntityName,
		sDeskName = sDeskName,
		AUName = AUName,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		Sales_Person = Sales_Person,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		ADENT = FromTeamMemberDB@ADENT,
		User_Name = User_Name,
		mo_AccessGroup = mo_AccessGroup
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> MergeJoin01
MergeJoin01 derive(CCP = CCP,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		LONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		INTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		MKey_BDteCRef = MKey_BDteCRef,
		modif_date = modif_date,
		Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Trader = Trader,
		npv_Change = npv_Change,
		fee_Change = fee_Change,
		lifecycle = lifecycle,
		Business_Date_Rpt = Business_Date_Rpt,
		Field_Amended = Field_Amended,
		Field_Mapping = Field_Mapping,
		Before = Before,
		After = After,
		Action_Status = Action_Status,
		End_Status = End_Status,
		Original_Status = Original_Status,
		Required_Approval = Required_Approval,
		oCalypso_Reference = oCalypso_Reference,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		DESK_MANAGER_NAME = DESK_MANAGER_NAME,
		sWellsEntityName = sWellsEntityName,
		sDeskName = sDeskName,
		AUName = AUName,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		Sales_Person = Sales_Person,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		ADENT = ADENT,
		User_Name = User_Name,
		mo_AccessGroup = mo_AccessGroup) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 derive(sAuGroup = toString((iif(isNull(ADENT), 'Front Office', 'Operations'))),
		sSystemSource = toString('Rates'),
		dCreateDate = toString($startTime)) ~> AddAuGroup
AddAuGroup derive(oPRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		oLONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		oINTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		oTRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		oTrade_Status = Trade_Status,
		oCCP = CCP,
		oPRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		oDESK_MANAGER_NAME = DESK_MANAGER_NAME,
		oPRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		oSHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME) ~> DataConversion1
DataConversion1 sink(input(
		Before as string,
		Group as string,
		Trading_Unit as string,
		WellsEntityName as string,
		Product_Sub_Type as string,
		Internal as string,
		Trade_Status as string,
		Trade_Id as string,
		AU_Group as string,
		System_Source as string,
		Amendment as double,
		Action_Status as string,
		Desk_Name as string,
		Desk_Manager_Name as string,
		End_Status as string,
		Modif_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Cpty_ShortName as string,
		Field_Mapping as string,
		Field_Amended as string,
		Create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MO_AccessGroup as string,
		Trade_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		User_Name as string,
		Trader as string,
		Cpty_LongName as string,
		Book_Name as string,
		CCP as string,
		Sales_Person as string,
		Product_Family as string,
		Required_Approval as string,
		After as string,
		Original_Status as string,
		Amendment_Cash as double,
		Product_Type as string,
		Lifecycle_Event as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 1000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Before,
		Group = AUName,
		Trading_Unit = oTRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		WellsEntityName = sWellsEntityName,
		Product_Sub_Type = oPRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		Internal = oINTERNAL,
		Trade_Status = oTrade_Status,
		Trade_Id = oCalypso_Reference,
		AU_Group = sAuGroup,
		System_Source = sSystemSource,
		Amendment = npv_Change,
		Action_Status,
		Desk_Name = sDeskName,
		Desk_Manager_Name = oDESK_MANAGER_NAME,
		End_Status,
		Modif_Date = modif_date,
		Cpty_ShortName = oSHORT_NAME,
		Field_Mapping,
		Field_Amended,
		Create_Dte = dCreateDate,
		MO_AccessGroup = mo_AccessGroup,
		Trade_Date = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		User_Name,
		Trader,
		Cpty_LongName = oLONG_NAME,
		Book_Name,
		CCP = oCCP,
		Sales_Person,
		Product_Family = oPRODUCT_FAMILY,
		Required_Approval,
		After,
		Original_Status,
		Amendment_Cash = fee_Change,
		Product_Type = oPRODUCT_TYPE,
		Lifecycle_Event = lifecycle),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoLifecycle_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoLifecycle
